summary: HMIC TRUST-ENROLLMENT / SIGNING TARGET SET RECONCILED -- EXACT SOURCE, CONTRACT-CONTENT, AND CONTRACT-VERSION MEMBERSHIP DERIVED. Reconciliation/analysis only; zero HMIC contract or production constant modified. This phase existed because 149O.20L.7O.2G's own report contained a load-bearing internal inconsistency: its Section 9.2/10 concluded HPSE-001 and HHCE-001 require both content and version HMIC binding (mirroring the HBDC-001 precedent), but its Section 9.1 total-count arithmetic (30 to 33) only reflected the 3 new Python source-file additions, never the 2 contract-content additions that same conclusion requires. This phase read HMIC-REQ-053 directly from the live contract text (not from 2G's summary): 'As of the 149O.20D.1 repair, every contract_versions member (HMIC-REQ-067, five entries) receives both bindings uniformly -- no contract_versions member is exempted from the digest binding.' This is a current, load-bearing textual rule of HMIC-001 itself, not an analogy or stylistic precedent -- every one of the five contracts currently in contract_versions is, without exception, also content-bound. It mechanically forces content binding for HPSE-001/HHCE-001 the instant either is added to contract_versions, independent of the semantic-drift argument (also independently reconstructed from the HBDC-001 precedent phase, 149O.20D.1, and found to generalize identically). Corrected exact future _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES membership: 35 entries (30 current + 3 source + 2 contract-content), not 33 -- 26 src/pcae/-relative entries (23 current + hatp_signing_ceremony.py + hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py + hatp_principal_signer_admin.py) plus 9 repository-root-relative entries (5 existing contracts + HATP_PRINCIPAL_SIGNER_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT.md [HPSE-001] + HATP_HARDWARE_CREDENTIAL_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT.md [HHCE-001] + 2 existing scripts). Contract-version set unchanged from 2G's own correct figure: 7 members (5 current + HPSE-001 v1.1 + HHCE-001 v1.1). The three Python source additions and the four excluded leaf dependencies (paths.py, provenance.py, git_status.py, tasks.py) were independently re-verified via direct grep/AST import inspection against live source, byte-identical to 2G's own Section 5 result -- no fourth candidate found, no exclusion reversed. HPSE-001's own Section 44 (HPSE-REQ-073) was read directly and confirmed to name only future source/script surfaces for a later HMIC source-scope analysis, correctly never claiming its own contract bytes as a closure-limb member -- HMIC-REQ-052 (source call-graph closure) and HMIC-REQ-053 (contract-content binding) are confirmed as genuinely distinct mechanisms, and the future limb (d) must not describe the two new contract documents as call-graph dependencies. Self-binding/digest transition analysis (hatp_mandatory_certification.py is itself a frozen member and would have its own bytes changed by 2H) found no sequencing problem, identical to the safely-used pattern at v1.3/v1.4 (149O.20K/149O.20L.7K) -- digests are always computed fresh at validation time, never cached stale. HMIC-001 version consequence unchanged: v1.4 to v1.5 (additive amendment, no removal, no weakening). Option A (one additive HMIC evolution, contract+production aligned in the same phase per the 149O.20L.7K precedent) reconfirmed still correct using the corrected 35/7 target set; Options B/C/D remain not supported by evidence, as 2G itself found. Finding B-149O.20L.7O.2G-1 disposition: RECONCILED -- EXACT TARGET SET DERIVED -- INDEPENDENT IMPLEMENTATION/CONTRACT EVOLUTION PENDING -- NOT CLOSED AT HMIC ALIGNMENT BOUNDARY. BF-1, BF-2, B-149O.20L.7O.2F.3-1, and B-149O.20L.7O.2F.3-2 unaffected, not reopened (zero commits to the relevant files since 2F.5/2G). Class-B verifier files and DeploymentBinding admin remain bound and unchanged; CBV-S1 unaffected (Class-B's own closure is already complete, this reconciliation concerns the separate Trust-Enrollment surface); CBV-S10 remains OPEN, untouched. A new 12-test reconciliation suite (mechanical baseline re-extraction, HMIC-REQ-053 uniform-coverage verification against live production state, candidate existence/non-membership, header parsing, the corrected 26/9/35/7 future-membership derivation including a test that would fail against 2G's uncorrected 33-entry figure, Class-B/DeploymentBinding-unchanged, no-production-constant-modified) passed 12/12. Fast Green exact node-ID diff against an isolated disposable worktree at this phase's own entry commit (03c585b3) found one current-only failure (tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence::test_audit_verify_cli, an unrelated pcae shell-gate audit verify CLI subprocess test with a 15-second timeout), independently re-run in isolation and confirmed to pass in 12.61 seconds once host load settled (it had failed once at 15.14s, immediately after two full parallel -n auto fast_green invocations completed) -- the identical system-load-induced timing-flake pattern 2G's own report already diagnosed for the same test under the same condition; this phase touched zero files related to shell-gate/audit, so 0 failed attributable to this phase's own changes.
